issues.description: The problem statement and template refer to a 'Rideable' interface, but the solution repository replaces that interface with a different-named 'Mountable' interface and leaves Rideable.java effectively empty. As a result, classes in the solution (Pig, Seal) implement Mountable rather than the expected Rideable, while the template/Main and the UML/specification expect Rideable. This mismatch of interface type names will confuse students about which interface to implement and break compatibility between template code, tests that expect Rideable, and the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Ensure consistent interface naming across all artifacts. Rename the Mountable interface in the solution to Rideable (or add a proper Rideable interface) and have Pig and Seal implement Rideable. Remove or repurpose the empty Rideable.java file so the interface with method signature messageOnRide() exists as Rideable. Update any references (Main, UML, and tests) to match the chosen interface name so students are not confused by differing type names.

issues.description: The exercise UML and the template code refer to the ride interface as 'Rideable' (problem statement and template Main.java), but the solution implementation uses a different identifier 'Mountable' for the same concept (interfaces and implementing classes). Additionally, the solution contains an empty Rideable.java file, increasing the inconsistency. This mismatch between 'Rideable' and 'Mountable' can confuse students when mapping the problem requirements to the provided solution and template code (which expect Rideable).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the interface name consistent across all artifacts. Rename the solution's 'Mountable' interface to 'Rideable' (or vice versa unify all artifacts to 'Mountable'), update Pig and Seal to implement the chosen name, and remove or populate the empty Rideable.java in the solution so the interface name matches the problem statement and template. Prefer aligning the solution to 'Rideable' to match the UML and template Main.java.
